name: web-console.native-thread-state
purpose: Observe native thread and goal state for an explicit bounded cohort without changing the threads.

threads.description: One to sixteen unique native thread IDs.

assumptions: Web Console enforces session read authority
A missing or unavailable goal is not an inferred completion
invariants: An ok envelope means observation succeeded, not that any goal succeeded
Thread state is an observation, not a deadline enforcement mechanism

signals.threads: Per-thread live owner and goal observations

outputs.evidence: The owner binding when the observation was obtained
